records.summary: About 60% of 2025 investment went to machines/servers.
records.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

evidence.quote: Approximately 60% of our investment in 2025, and it's going to be fairly similar in 2026, went towards machines; so, the servers.

records.summary: Machine/server share expected to be fairly similar in 2026.
records.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

evidence.quote: Approximately 60% of our investment in 2025, and it's going to be fairly similar in 2026, went towards machines; so, the servers.

records.summary: About 40% of investment went to long-duration assets like data centers and networking equipment.
records.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi, SVP and CFO, Alphabet and Google

evidence.quote: And then 40% is what you would refer to as long duration assets, which is our data centers and networking equipment.

evidence.quote: Approximately 60% of our investment in 2025, and it's going to be fairly similar in 2026, went towards machines; so, the servers. And then 40% is what you would refer to as long duration assets, which is our data centers and networking equipment.

records.summary: Buildings may depreciate over 40 years or longer; other components less.

qualifiers.quote: Other components may be less than that.

records.summary: Just over half of ML compute expected to go to Cloud in 2026.

gaps: No explicit 2026 long-duration asset percentage is stated; only 'fairly similar' to 2025's 40%.
No explicit 2026 machine share percentage is stated; only 'fairly similar' to 2025's 60%.
